say:1:1510668001:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Are you all right? Are you hurt?
say:1:1510668001:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Are you all right? Are you hurt?
say:1:1510668001:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Are you all right? Are you hurt?

say:2:1510668002:1.text: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!
say:2:1510668002:1.source_cn: 终于见到您了，我很担心！
say:2:1510668002:1.male: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!
say:2:1510668002:1.female: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!

choice_prompt:3:1510668002.text: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!
choice_prompt:3:1510668002.source_cn: 终于见到您了，我很担心！
choice_prompt:3:1510668002.male: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!
choice_prompt:3:1510668002.female: I was so worried! I'm so relieved to see you!

say:4:1510668003:0.text: Yes. I know. But... I still feel so uneasy.
say:4:1510668003:0.source_cn: 是的。我知道。但……心里仍然非常不安。
say:4:1510668003:0.male: Yes. I know. But... I still feel so uneasy.
say:4:1510668003:0.female: Yes. I know. But... I still feel so uneasy.

say:6:1510668004:0.text: Not bad, kiddo. You're still alive too.
say:6:1510668004:0.source_cn: 不错，小家伙，你也还活着。

say:8:1510668005:0.text: Little emissary, what's that in your hand...?

say:10:1510668006:1.text: Look, I found this in some ruins.
say:10:1510668006:1.source_cn: 请看，这是我在一处废墟中捡到的。

say:11:1510668007:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I ran into a lot of monsters when we were separated. But they didn't come near me.
say:11:1510668007:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I ran into a lot of monsters when we were separated. But they didn't come near me.
say:11:1510668007:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I ran into a lot of monsters when we were separated. But they didn't come near me.

say:12:1510668008:1.text: It wasn't until much later that I realized they were avoiding this stone tablet at my feet.
say:12:1510668008:1.source_cn: 后来，我发现，其实它们是不想接近这石板。它一直躺在我的脚边。
say:12:1510668008:1.male: It wasn't until much later that I realized they were avoiding this stone tablet at my feet.
say:12:1510668008:1.female: It wasn't until much later that I realized they were avoiding this stone tablet at my feet.

say:13:1510668009:0.text: It felt... strange. So I picked it up, thinking I should bring it to you.
say:13:1510668009:0.source_cn: 这种情况很不寻常。所以我捡起石板，希望能将它带给您。
say:13:1510668009:0.male: It felt... strange. So I picked it up, thinking I should bring it to you.
say:13:1510668009:0.female: It felt... strange. So I picked it up, thinking I should bring it to you.

say:14:1510668010:1.text: After that, I saw this place light up in the distance and followed the light all the way here.
say:14:1510668010:1.source_cn: 再之后，我远远看到这里亮了起来，一路追寻，这才找到了您。
say:14:1510668010:1.male: After that, I saw this place light up in the distance and followed the light all the way here.
say:14:1510668010:1.female: After that, I saw this place light up in the distance and followed the light all the way here.

say:15:1510668011:1.text: You take a closer look at the tablet Gala found. Unlike the other two mural fragments, this one just has a few patches of color and doesn't seem to show anything.
say:15:1510668011:1.source_cn: 你仔细端详着加拉捡到的石板。和你们捡到的两块壁画碎片不...

say:16:1510668012:0.text: But the texture and worn edges tell you that it must also be part of the mural at the Harvest Altar.
say:16:1510668012:0.source_cn: 但它的质感和边缘磨损的痕迹告诉你，它一定也来自丰饶祭坛...

choice_prompt:17:1510668012.text: But the texture and worn edges tell you that it must also be part of the mural at the Harvest Altar.
choice_prompt:17:1510668012.source_cn: 但它的质感和边缘磨损的痕迹告诉你，它一定也来自丰饶祭坛上的那幅壁画。

say:21:1510668014:1.text: There is a gigantic mural at the Harvest Altar, depicting the people of Tuttleton making an offering of light to the God of Harvest. You'll see it when we go back there.
say:21:1510668014:1.source_cn: 一幅位于丰饶祭坛之上的壁画，描绘的是图塔镇为丰饶神献上...

say:22:1510668015:0.text: For now, we should focus on finding that key Tully mentioned.
say:22:1510668015:0.source_cn: 至于现在，还是尽快找到塔利说的那把钥匙吧。

say:23:1510668016:0.text: Sedecim, do you know where Tully kept the key?
say:23:1510668016:0.source_cn: 十六，你知道塔利把钥匙放在哪里了吗？

say:31:1510668020:0.text: Master... told me <style="highlight">in my heart</style>, to keep safe... an important... <style="highlight">mission</style>.

say:33:1510668021:0.text: An important mission? What is it?

say:36:1510668023:0.text: Leave the puppet alone. Finding the <style="highlight">key</style> is what's important.

choice:28:1:2.text: You reacted just like we did!
choice:28:1:2.source_cn: 和我们最开始一样的反应！
choice:28:1:2.male: You reacted just like we did!
choice:28:1:2.female: You reacted just like we did!

choice:17:0:1.text: This is also part of the mural.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 这块石板也是祭坛壁画的一部分
choice:17:0:1.male: This is also part of the mural.
choice:17:0:1.female: This is also part of the mural.
